instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: Stella loves music. Last year she had <mat>700</mat> vinyls. This year her collection increased by <mat>6%</mat>. How many vinyls did Stella’s collection increase by?

Mike and Mitch want to make some extra money during the summer holidays. They sell lemonade and make <mat>£70</mat>. Since Mike bought all the ingredients to make the lemonade, they agreed that he would get <mat>65%</mat> of the profits. How much money does Mike get?

Kirk bought a new pair of trousers for <mat>£25</mat> at the flea market. One year later, he bought the same pair on the internet because it was reduced by <mat>32%</mat>. How much money was the pair on the internet reduced by?

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: A school has <mat>2400</mat> pupils. <mat>26%</mat> of all pupils are learning a second language in school. How many pupils at the school are learning a second language?
atoms.b: <mat><gap>624</gap></mat> pupils are learning a second language.

atoms.a: Kevin is reading a book with <mat>580</mat> pages. He has already read <mat>15%</mat> of the book. How many pages of the book does he have left?

Bob is renovating his house. His budget is <mat>£5000</mat>. He has spent <mat>82%</mat> of his budget on a bathtub, a new sofa and a new mattress. After buying these three items, how much money has he already spent?
atoms.b: Bob has spent <mat>£<gap>4100</gap></mat> of his budget.
